post.description:
Vector + full-text search over facts valid at `valid_at` as known at `known_at`,
pre-filtered by tenant, privacy scope and metadata; each result explains its score.
Results may come from the shared retrieval cache (`cache: "hit"`).

Runs hybrid search with `known_at` pinned (default: now) and stores the result
immutably. Cite its fact versions when recording the decision.

VersionSnapshot.title: VersionSnapshot
VersionSnapshot.description:
An immutable copy of one fact version, as seen at some point in transaction time.

When a snapshot is taken "as known at K" and the version's end had not been
learned yet at K, ``valid_until`` and ``valid_until_recorded_at`` are None:
at that moment the version looked open-ended.
